R1_the_defect.readiness_language_bounded: ready: false means ONE checked precondition does not hold right now. It is not a prediction that every possible new Job must fail; the callers reaching driver._accepted_receipts are not all traced and the detail says so.

R1_the_defect.the_fix: Checks has three categories: `check` REQUIRED decides whether the run completed; `readiness` is a checked precondition; `diagnostic` enters NEITHER conjunction. readiness_failed selects on kind == 'readiness', so a diagnostic can never reach it.
